topic: Liver regeneration: regrows after partial removal, living donation
hook: Lose half your liver. It grows back.

slides.title: Most of it can go
slides.body: Surgeons can remove up to about 70% of a healthy liver.

caption:
Your liver is the only organ in your body that can regrow lost mass. After surgeons remove a large part of a healthy liver, the remaining cells start dividing and rebuild it to near full size within weeks.

This is why living liver donation works. Both the donor's piece and the part left behind grow to fit the body they're in. Source: Mayo Clinic and NIH research on liver regeneration.
